upd_intro: The builds of the phone and desktop apps this hub offers, and where it gets them. The web is served by the hub itself and changes when the hub does.
upd_from_source_hint: The hub reads GitHub releases itself instead of you uploading them.
upd_token_hint: For a private repository. Written once, never shown.
upd_token_stored: Stored. Type a new one to replace it.
upd_auto_publish: Publish to the test channel automatically
upd_auto_publish_hint: Every new release at the source is published to test on its own.
upd_empty_body: What is published here is what the phone and desktop apps find. None of them is on the shelf yet.
upd_delete_body: It disappears from the update list. A build already downloaded keeps working.
